text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the day of the URA award ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All of the year's most illustrious faces gather there, including…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, Mihono Bourbon, Oguri Cap, and Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian uses her award acceptance speech to challenge every racer in attendance to a battle for the top.
